App.BookPriceInvalid: Price must be zero or greater
App.BooksTierL1Hint: Reference for custom data sources: a source callback passed to useAbpTable, no service descriptor.
App.BooksTierL2Hint: Below the ABP layer: the generic server-paged table on raw hooks.
App.BookTypeHint: Leave empty to keep it unclassified; you can set it later
App.BookStockInvalid: Stock must be a whole number of 0 or more
App.BookStockRequired: A book on sale needs stock
App.BookDescriptionPlaceholder: One or two sentences about the book
App.BookPromoHint: Leave the promotion period empty if there is none; both ends are inclusive.
App.BookPromoInvalid: The promotion must end on or after its start
App.BookInStockHint: Off-sale books stay in the catalogue but can't be ordered
App.BookSectionSalesHint: Books on sale can't be deleted; take them off sale first.
App.BookDeleteConfirm: The book and its sales history will be removed. This can't be undone.
App.BookScenarioDefaultHint: The standard list: search, the filter panel, sorting, view settings, row menu, bulk actions and export are all live.
App.BookScenarioViewHint: Density is compact and Summary is hidden. The view-settings icon shows a dot; its panel ends with Restore default view.
App.BookScenarioFilteredHint: Filtered to science fiction on sale. The filter icon shows a dot, the chips row says what is applied, and the filters are in the URL.
App.BookScenarioSelectAllHint: This page is selected. The strip above the table offers to extend the selection to every matching book; the bulk bar replaces the search box.
App.BookScenarioEmptyHint: The endpoint returns nothing. The empty state says what to do next: create the first book.
App.BookScenarioNoMatchHint: Data exists but nothing matches. The empty state offers Clear filters instead of New.
App.BookScenarioFailingHint: The last refresh failed. The previous rows stay, dimmed, with a banner and Retry. Click Default to recover.
App.BookScenarioLongHint: 50 rows per page. Scroll inside the table: the header stays pinned.
